title: CONNECT-IP ADDRESS_ASSIGN Capsule Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 ADDRESS_ASSIGN capsule wire format and complete assignment-list semantics.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpAddressAssignCapsule` creates and parses Capsule Type 0x01 using the generic Capsule codec, while `Http3ConnectIpAssignedAddress` validates Request ID, IP Version, address length, prefix length, zero host bits, and prefix source-address permissions. Assignment-list application treats each ADDRESS_ASSIGN capsule as a complete replacement list.
data_and_state_considerations: The codec returns immutable assignment snapshots. It does not own tunnel state; callers apply the complete list to their tunnel assignment store.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Malformed capsule fields map to HTTP/3 message errors.
Empty ADDRESS_ASSIGN payloads remove all prior assignments.
Omitted prior addresses are removed because each capsule carries the complete current list.
risks: ADDRESS_REQUEST and ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT capsules remain separate RFC 9484 slices.
Live address installation and packet forwarding remain adapter work.
